newsitem.title: GERMANY: Veba sees mobile telecom breakeven by 99.
newsitem.headline: Veba sees mobile telecom breakeven by 99.

text.p: The head of diversified utility Veba AG's telecommunications unit said on Wednesday that he expected the group's mobile telephone business to be profitable by 1999.
Hermann Kraemer told journalists that he also expected the group's fixed network to be profitable by 2002.
Earlier in the day, Veba management board chairman Ulrich Hartmann said the group planned to continue to expand its telecoms division.
In 1996, its E-plus mobile unit brought its customer base up to 500,000 subscribers, more than doubling the previous year's figure.
Veba's telecoms unit made start-up losses of 208 million marks in 1996.
